title: Idempotency keyed on (order, amount) swallows the second refund
body: Tried before and rejected. Partial refunds legitimately share an order and can share an amount, so keying idempotency on (order_id, amount_cents) silently swallows the second legitimate refund -- the customer is left short and nothing errors. Key on the client-supplied request_id instead: it is stable across retries and unique per request. Use instead: request_id.
evidence: PR #412: two 20-dollar refunds on order o1 with different request ids; the second returned the first result and the customer was short 20 dollars
author: payments-team
